arguments.code:
# Find husband's contact(s) in phone book and send him one favorite recipe name

phone_token = phone_token  # from earlier login

# loop through paginated contacts for relationship='husband'
all_contacts=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship='husband', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page',page_index,'len',len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_contacts.extend(page)
    if len(page)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1
print('total husband contacts',len(all_contacts))
for c in all_contacts:
    print(c.get('contact_id'), c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), c.get('phone_number'), c.get('email'), c.get('relationships'))

# Determine a favorite recipe name from Simple Note (from Food Recipes note already loaded)
favorite_recipe_name = None
content = note.get('content')
# parse lines: look for pattern 'name:' and 'favorite: true'
# We'll iterate blocks: when we see 'name:' store; when we later see 'favorite: true' set if pending name.
lines = content.splitlines()
current_name=None
for line in lines:
    if line.strip().startswith('name:'):
        current_name = line.split('name:',1)[1].strip()
    if line.strip().lower() == 'favorite: true':
        if current_name:
            favorite_recipe_name = current_name
            break
print('favorite_recipe_name',favorite_recipe_name)

# Send SMS to each husband contact phone_number
sent_ids=[]
for c in all_contacts:
    pn=str(c.get('phone_number'))
    if not pn or pn=='None':
        continue
    send_res=apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=pn, message=favorite_recipe_name, access_token=phone_token)
    print('sent to',pn,'res',send_res)
    sent_ids.append(send_res.get('text_message_id'))

print('sent_ids',sent_ids)
